resources.string: This device shares nothing with you
No device shares a folder with you yet
Devices appear here when they share a folder with Taildrive and the tailnet\'s access rules let this device in. On Windows and macOS the Tailscale app has to be open.
It may be off or asleep. On Windows and macOS the Tailscale app serves the files, so it has to be open.
The tailnet\'s access rules do not let this device in. An admin can allow it in the policy.
The share or the folder is no longer on the device.
The device is slow to answer, or the connection is poor. Try again.
The Taildrive proxy is not answering
It is on, but nothing listens on its address yet. It starts with the connection; if another app holds the port, change it in the Taildrive settings.
Files open without it. The proxy is needed only to open a file by link, and for other devices on your network to reach the shares through this one.
No app can open this file
Install a media player such as VLC, Kodi or Just Player, or open the file\'s address on another device.
No app on this device opens this kind of file. Its address works on another device.
Any device on the tailnet with Taildrive access can open this address. Scan the code with a phone.
